purpose: Turn the zero-outcome baseline into a concrete manual outreach plan for getting real, non-owner, permissioned public evidence that can eventually unlock stronger resume claims.
resume_safe_summary: Added a real reviewer outreach playbook with 5 contact pools, 5 evidence targets, copy-ready asks, recording commands, and strict counting boundaries for converting future external reviews into resume-safe outcome claims.
today_completion_definition: Choose one real person from the first contact pool.
Send the copy-ready message outside the repo.
Record only the sent event with scripts/record_reviewer_outreach_event.py.
Do not change user, feedback, star, or business-impact counts until public evidence is accepted.
